_comment: WOLF v1.0 RISK-OFF book — defensives + short-risk rotation leg of the regime-rotation fund. Trades ONLY when the shared cross-asset regime detector confirms RISK-OFF (net of equities-up / oil-down / gold-soft / BTC-up / dollar-soft votes <= -regimeThreshold). It then goes LONG defensives that are trending up (gold/oil/dollar/yen) and SHORT risk assets rolling over (riskAssets): 4h backbone + 1h confirm + momentum + RSI room. When the regime is RISK-ON or NEUTRAL this book STANDS DOWN and emits no signals. Leverage clamped to maxLeverage then each asset's HL venue max. Pairs with the RISK-ON book (wolf-risk_on-config.json) on a SEPARATE wallet. Set wallet/strategyId/chatId. Runtime owns position tracking, caps, cooldowns, DSL via runtime-risk_off.yaml. Producer launched with WOLF_LEG=risk_off.
_persona: Regime-rotation defensives + short-risk — fires only in a confirmed RISK-OFF regime, longs defensives (gold/oil/dollar/yen) trending up and shorts the risk complex rolling over, strict 5x, TIGHTER DSL (risk-off moves are sharp and reverse fast). Stands down in RISK-ON / NEUTRAL. defensives = LONG candidates; riskAssets = SHORT candidates.
